Q: VScode crashed (reason: 'oom', code: '-536870904') A:

I had this problem as well, where running virtually any command in the VS Code terminal would cause this crash.

I was able to fix it by setting "terminal.integrated.stickyScroll.enabled": false in my VS Code settings.json (use the "Preferences: Open User Settings (JSON)" command after hitting Ctrl+Shift+P to open it).

Q: JSON response difference in Spring Boot v3 and v4 A:

spring.jackson.use-jackson2-defaults=true should help

If you prefer at least initially keep using default settings as close as possible as Jackson 2, you can use the spring.jackson.use-jackson2-defaults property. When set to true, the auto-configured JsonMapper will have defaults that align as closely as possible with those of Jackson 2 in Spring Boot 3. https://spring.io/blog/2025/10/07/introducing-jackson-3-support-in-spring

Q: How do I update Node.js? A:

According to the Node.js official page, you can install and update a new Node.js version on Windows using Chocolatey or Scoop.

Using Chocolatey:

cinst nodejs

# Or for a full install with npm
cinst nodejs.install

Using Scoop:

scoop install nodejs

Also, you can download the Windows Installer directly from the nodejs.org web site.

Q: Certificate for <jcenter.bintray.com> doesn't match any of the subject alternative names A:

I just ran into the same exact problem. I cleared my cache and restarted the IDE.

File > Invalidate Caches/Restart > Invalidate and Restart

Q: how to run regression tests with jenkins A:

As CI server, Jenkins is built to

run regression tests

It is plugin based, so you will find it can do pretty much anything you will ever need. It is really a matter of project specific setup. Also, supports different OS for the Nodes

As to desktop apps, when it comes to SendKeys and other interactive methods (I assume the process you run is GUI application), you need to run Jenkins slave agent able to deal with active desktop session, e.g. jnlp or as (my) workaround - setup keep-alive job every 3 mins.

Q: How to make awesome font work in Spring Boot with PrimeFaces A:

You don't need to create a web xml, just add the dependency and in your application.properties add this:

jsf.primefaces.font-awesome=true

And if you what to configure a theme add this:

jsf.primefaces.theme= theme-name
